note: Non-ASCII characters VERIFIED present in Latin Modern Roman, the main font every book in this corpus sets. Generated by querying lmroman10-regular.otf's cmap, then committed -- the font ships with TeX Live and is not resolvable from a plain checkout, so the answer is recorded rather than recomputed. A character NOT in this list and NOT given a \newunicodechar mapping in the book's preamble reaches the reader as a missing glyph, which is a CI failure and has happened twice: ae-with-macron in Latin (HL-C214) and open-o in Bengali (HL-C223).
howToAdd: Query the font before adding: if the character is present, add it here with its name. If it is absent, either choose a character that is present, or add a \newunicodechar mapping to EVERY book's preamble that uses it -- the Indic romanization marks are handled that way already.
